# Migrating the birding club mailing list

The Harlow Junction Birding Club meets in the branch community room and asked staff for help moving its member list off an old email program. Library staff are not responsible for the list, but a reference librarian helped the club export it.

The migration moved 214 member addresses into a new mailing system. About thirty addresses bounced on the first message, and the club is calling those members. The club also left a printed copy at the front desk in case the new system fails before the spring bird count.
